build_llm_reward_model: build an LLM with runner=pooling to generate rewards for a list of text prompts
create_parse_args_cli: create a CLI argument parser with engine args and reward model defaults
run_reward_inference: run reward inference on sample prompts and return a list of PoolingRequestOutput
print_embeddings_rewards: print reward embeddings for each prompt output using print_embeddings
summarize_reward_outputs: summarize the reward model outputs by extracting output.outputs.data for each prompt
